attBesluta.text: Absolutely love it, though it should’ve been a little bit deeper for each kayak, it is a little small for certain kayaks, but love the design and the way it’s made.
De kajaks zijn er fijn op te leggen en handig vanaf te halen!

i use it to store my windsurf, surf and foil boards. very solid rack, with nice soft bars and allows to adjust bar positions for my different board thickness. if i need to extend storage, will go for the same one
Zeer solide en mooi afgewerkt. Heel blij mee. Omdat muur niet stevig genoeg is op houten frame gemonteerd. (Foto op z’n kop!)

We have 4 kayaks and a paddleboard. We were stacking them on top of each other and inevitably the one you want is on the bottom. Our storage shed is approx. 6'5" tall so we had to place the rack in just the right place. We chose to put the longest one on a rug under the rack (still very accessible). The construction was better than expected but still wobbles a little bit I know it's very secure. Here's a tip: start the screws with your fingers or you risk cross-threading as my husband found out using the drill from the get-go. It wound be nice if the company included 2 additional screws.
Parfait! conforme à mes attentes. Merci
Tres moelleux et ne bouge pas au lave-linge.
Better than expected for the price.

Of the 2 loungers I ordered one arrived with a seriously bent metal support leg. Vevor reimbursed me in full for the damaged lounger so I am completely satisfied. The undamaged lounger I received of the 2 I ordered is comfortable and perfect for the space I needed it in.

There were problems with delivery, but everything was compensated and the money was returned. They lie on the forums that the customer support is bad. That's a lie. The support service solves problems even late in the evening. By the way, the sofa is of normal quality and after three weeks of daily use, the cushion fillings have not lost their shape. The strong frame construction is very reliable and squeak-free. I couldn't find a similar design for a chair with a basket for blankets and small items.
Delivered on time. Easy to assemble, looks awesome Dark brown loveseat. Fits perfect in camper pullout. Lastly so very comfortable.
Très bien ce canapé facile à monter, Vévor vous fournit une vidéo de montage l'assise me convient bien, facile d'entretien bref je ne regrette pas mon achat j'espère le garder longtemps.
